foundation.framingA.title: Uyu ni umubonano wacu wa mbere.
foundation.framingA.body:
Ibibazo birindwi byuje ituze — ariko ushobora guhagarika nyuma y'ibitatu ukabona ibisubizo byawe bya mbere.

Nta bisubizo byiza bihari. Ubudahemuka buruta ubwiza.

Ibi si ikizamini. Ni ifoto ya mbere yerekana aho uri ubu, kugira ngo nshobore kugusangayo.
foundation.framingB.title: Uru nirwo rufatiro rwawe.
foundation.framingB.body:
Ibyo umaze kumpa bihinduka urwego rwawe rw'intangiriro.

Mu minsi iri imbere nkomeza kongera kwisuzuma — ibi si ikizamini, ni ifoto ya mbere.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Simbukira imbere — erekana ibisubizo byange ubu
foundation.q1.title: Ni uwuhe muri izi ngeso wumva wiganje cyane muri wowe ubu?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Kugeza kuri 3. Ba inyangamugayo.
foundation.q1.opt3: Guhunga — kuyoba, kureba kuri terefone, kwibagirwa
foundation.q1.opt4: Impungenge — ubwoba bumwe, inkuru imwe, ihuriro rimwe
foundation.q1.opt5: Gushimisha abandi — sinshobora kuvuga ngo oya
foundation.q1.opt6: Umwirondoro — 'ndi nde nyamara?' ntishira mu mutwe
foundation.q2.title: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwitoreza ushobora kwihanganira koko ubu?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Atari ukwifuza. Icyo ubuzima bwawe bw'ubu bushobora kwemera.
foundation.q2.opt1: Byoroheje — umugenzo umwe mutoya, uzaramba iteka
foundation.q2.opt2: Bisanzwe — imyitozo ya buri munsi, ku rwego ruringaniye
foundation.q2.opt3: Gukaza — ndashaka imbaraga, ndashaka ko bisya
foundation.q2.opt4: Gukara cyane — ndashaka ko umunsi munini ugenda utyo
foundation.q3.title: Iyo wibaza ku cyitegererezo cyiza cyawe, baba ari...
foundation.q3.opt1: Biyemeje — biga buri gihe, bihora bihinduka
foundation.q3.opt2: Mu rukundo — bihindutse ikintu kinini cyane
foundation.q3.opt3: Bihagarara neza — bica mu kintu icyo ari cyo cyose
foundation.q3.opt5: Hagati y'isi — bareba ibyo abandi batabona
foundation.q3.opt6: Ubuhumekero bwiza abantu bakira hafi yabwo
foundation.q3.opt9: Bari mu nzu / mu bwami / mu kipe neza
foundation.q3.opt10: Kwangira ibinyoma — n'iyo waba uri wenyine
foundation.q4.title: Ni iyihe rembo iri hafi yawe cyane ubu?
foundation.q4.opt1: Ubwitange — umuziki, amarira, kwishyira mu maboko
foundation.q4.opt6: Gukora ku mbaraga — umwuka, ikoranabuhanga ryo muri twe, ubuzima
foundation.q5.title: Ni iki uri hano kugira ngo wongere utekerezeho?
foundation.q5.opt1: Ukwemera nzitwaje kuva mu bwana bwanjye
foundation.q6.title: Ni iki cyumvikana ko ari ukuri cyane?
foundation.q7.title: Iyo ikintu kitoroshye kibaye, ujya hehe mbere na mbere?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Menya intambwe ya mbere cyane.
foundation.q7.opt1: Mu mutwe wanjye — sesengura, tegura, subira
foundation.q7.opt2: Mu mutima wanjye — wumve, ugera ku muntu
foundation.q7.opt3: Mu bikorwa — yegera, kosora, kora ikintu
foundation.q8.title: Uzi ute kureba ibitekerezo byawe bwite?
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Ibi bizahinduka uko witoza. Nta na kimwe kidahinduka — icyo ni cyo cyose.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Tuzongera gusoma ibi nyuma y'iminsi mike. Amatsinda ariyimura. Icyo ni cyo cyose.
foundation.brain.head.label: Uyobowe n'umutwe
foundation.brain.heart.label: Uyobowe n'umutima
foundation.brain.gut.label: By'amara y'inda
foundation.brain.head.line: Ubanziza gutekereza. Turabihaha agaciro, hanyuma twigishe umubiri kugera kuri urwo rwego.
foundation.brain.heart.line: Ubanziza kumva. Tuzakomeza urugi rufunguye, twongereho umuhamya inyuma yabyo.
foundation.brain.gut.line: Ubanziza kwikorera. Turagutinda gato gusa kugira ngo wumve ibiri hepfo yabyo.
foundation.analysis.loopsEmpty: Nta kirasakuza cyane — tuzabibona mu byo dukora.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Ushobora burigihe kugaruka ku byo wasomye nyuma binyuze mu igenamiterne. Nta na kimwe kidahinduka.
foundation.paths.title: Hitamo abagenzi bafatanya nawe.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Gutumbira ni cyo gishingo — buri nzira yose ihera aho. Hitamo inzira 2–3 zumvikana neza kuri wowe ubu. Ushobora burigihe kongeraho izindi nyuma.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Kureba ibiriho, nta gufata cyangwa gusunikira. Buri nzira yose tugendana itangirira kuri uyu mwanya.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Uyu ni wo mwanya wo gutangirira — si mu nzu y'imbohe. Inzira yawe izagenda ihinduka uko nawe uhinduka.
foundation.archetype.creator: Umuremyi
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Imirimo y'ingufu binyuze mu guhumeka n'uburyo bw'imbere.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Igikorwa kitagira aho gihuriye. Gukorera nk'isengesho.
foundation.path.tantra.blurb: Byose ni byera. Nta na kimwe gisigara inyuma.
